issues.description: The problem statement requires the main function to return 0 to indicate successful execution (problem_statement.md lines 21-22), but the solution explicitly sets eax to 1 before returning (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm line 17: 'mov eax, 1'). This contradicts the stated requirement and can cause automated checks or student expectations to fail. The template also does not initialize the return value (template_repository/helloWorld.asm ends with 'ret' without setting eax), leaving students uncertain whether they must set eax themselves. The solution demonstrating a non-zero return value is therefore an unintentional structural inconsistency that can confuse students and break the acceptance criterion.
issues.suggested_fix: Ensure the solution and/or template conform to the requirement that main returns 0. For example, in the solution change 'mov eax, 1' to 'mov eax, 0' (or remove the incorrect mov and add 'mov eax, 0' before 'ret'). Alternatively, make the template explicitly set 'mov eax, 0' before 'ret' so students clearly see the expected return value. If the intention was to require a non-zero return, update the problem statement to reflect that.
